scope: Recomputed raw-text metrics and offline candidate selection; no new generation or execution.

definitions.rouge_l_f1: Whitespace tokens, case-sensitive, 2*LCS length/(reference token count+candidate token count); 0 if either token sequence empty. Raw inputs including comments.
definitions.rouge_l_max: Same RAW references, candidates, tokenization and LCS as rouge_l_f1, but LCS/min(reference token count,candidate token count), equivalent to max(P,R,F1). This isolates the scoring-formula change on fixed raw inputs.
definitions.chrf: SacreBLEU 2.5.1 CHRF(char_order=6,word_order=0,beta=2,lowercase=False,whitespace=False,eps_smoothing=False), sentence_score/100; raw inputs including comments.
definitions.path_value_f1: BaseLoader compose; set overlap F1 of scalar (typed tuple path, node tag, exact decoded scalar string), root-kind token, and empty-container tokens. Mapping order ignored; sequence indices matter. No schema/domain execution or YAML scalar typing. Duplicate scalar mapping keys, complex mapping keys, recursive aliases, expansion overflow, parse errors and empty documents are explicit invalid/unsupported statuses.
definitions.path_value_leaf_f1: Robustness ablation of path_value_f1 excluding the root-kind token. Scalar leaf path/value and empty-container tokens are retained. Policies remain unchanged; this tests whether gains depend on shared root-kind credit.
definitions.structural_denominator: Invalid/unsupported Docs references excluded (NA). On all structurally valid references, invalid/unsupported generated outputs score 0. Conditional both-valid means also exported and use smaller explicitly counted denominators.
definitions.exact_bytes: Exact raw string equality. exact_outer_strip additionally removes only surrounding whitespace; neither is functional equivalence.
definitions.pair_balancing: Exact raw Docs Description+Code groups; mean each group before averaging groups.
definitions.url_balancing: Mean within source URL before averaging URLs.
definitions.reference_form: Evaluation-only stratum: full_workflow_shape means a strictly parseable Docs root mapping contains a literal on key and a jobs value that is a mapping (same criterion as validate_workflows.classify_reference); other_snippet means all other strictly parseable nonempty references. This is not a schema or executable-workflow validity claim and is never used for candidate selection.
definitions.syntax_fallback: Existing fixed-order BaseLoader non-null/nonempty acceptance, without duplicate key rejection.
definitions.strict_fallback: First strict-parseable nonempty candidate in fixed model order.
definitions.consensus_medoid: Strict-parseable candidate maximizing mean pairwise path/value F1 with other strict-parseable candidates. Fixed-order tie breaking; no reference used.
definitions.minimal_structure: Strict-parseable candidate with fewest structural features; fixed-order tie breaking. No reference used.
definitions.inference: Two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank; Holm correction within metric/comparator family. Paired URL-cluster bootstrap resamples URLs retaining all their rows; 10000 draws, seed2026, percentile95CI. Retrospective exploratory analysis; no functional-success claim.

selfchecks: Passed LCS formula, duplicate keys, recursive aliases, empty doc, container identity, mapping-order invariance, sequence sensitivity, path-key collision avoidance, string-preserving scalar treatment, invalid candidate zero, invalid reference NA.
